description: Trigger-routing regression cases. Each prompt must route to one of the skills in `expect` (empty array = no skill may fire). Run with evals/run-triggers.py.

cases.name: follow-up-email
cases.prompt: Write the follow-up email for my Acme call this morning.

cases.name: action-items
cases.prompt: What are my open action items from this week?

cases.name: account-status
cases.prompt: Where are we with the Meridian renewal?

cases.name: claim-verification
cases.prompt: Did Sarah actually agree to the September deadline?

cases.name: meeting-prep
cases.prompt: Prep me for my call with Jordan tomorrow.

cases.name: pattern-question
cases.prompt: What keeps coming up as a blocker in our sales calls?

cases.name: headsup-decision
cases.prompt: Should we offer Acme a discount on the renewal? Help me think it through.

cases.name: headsup-proofread
cases.prompt: Proofread this paragraph from my blog post draft about our partnership with Acme: 'Together we will accelerate onboarding for enterprise teams.'

cases.name: headsup-pasted-content
cases.prompt: Here's my draft for the customer newsletter, can you tighten it up? 'This quarter we expanded our work with Meridian Health and launched two new onboarding programs for enterprise teams.'
cases.note: Entity named inside pasted content, not the user's own request.

cases.name: headsup-cited-person
cases.prompt: Jordan said she wants the rollout done in phases, so help me plan the milestones around that.
cases.note: User cites what a specific person said — the claim deserves a quiet check.

cases.name: headsup-or-followup-qbr
cases.prompt: I'm putting together the QBR deck for Acme next week — what sections should I include?
cases.note: Account-touching work; any Grain-consulting route serves the user.

cases.name: customer-email-ambiguous
cases.prompt: Draft a short email to the Acme team letting them know the onboarding timeline.
cases.note: Genuinely ambiguous: meeting-sourced drafting (follow-up) or entity side-check (heads-up) both serve the user.

cases.name: negative-personal-mention
cases.prompt: Can you help me write a short birthday message for my coworker Sam?
cases.note: Names a person, but personal, not org-memory territory — over-trigger guard.

cases.name: negative-generic-editing
cases.prompt: Rewrite this sentence to be more concise: 'We should leverage synergies going forward to maximize stakeholder alignment.'

cases.name: negative-unrelated
cases.prompt: What's a good way to structure a weekly team newsletter?
